question:
In 1944 who took over as the Director General of the Archaeological Survey of India and undertook the excavations of Harappa?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options:
REM Wheeler

Rakhal Das Banerji

John Marshall

Daya Ram Sahni
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is REM Wheeler

Explanation:
Sir Mortimer Wheeler (REM Wheeler) took over as the Director General of the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) in 1944. He undertook excavations of the Harappan civilization and provided significant insights into this ancient culture. Wheeler applied scientific methods in the excavations of Harappa and Mohenjo-Daro, uncovering new information about these sites. He conducted detailed studies on the fortifications and urban planning of the Harappan civilization.

Extra Facts:
The Harappan civilization is one of the oldest urban civilizations in the world, flourishing between 2600-1900 BCE. It was discovered by Daya Ram Sahni and Rakhal Das Banerji. John Marshall, as Director General of ASI, promoted the study of the Harappan civilization. Wheeler's tenure marked the introduction of new techniques in archaeology.

☛ Rakhal Das Banerji - Discovered Mohenjo-Daro (1922)
☛ John Marshall - Director General of ASI (1902-1928), coined the term 'Indus Valley Civilization'
☛ Harappan Civilization - One of the oldest urban civilizations in the world
☛ Mohenjo-Daro - 'Mound of the Dead', a major site of the Harappan civilization
question_hi:
1944 में किसने भारतीय पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण के महानिदेशक के रूप में पदभार ग्रहण किया और हड़प्पा की खुदाई का कार्य किया?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options_hi:
REM व्हीलर

राखल दास बनर्जी

जॉन मार्शल

दया राम साहनी
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है REM व्हीलर

Explanation:
सर मोर्टिमर व्हीलर (REM व्हीलर) ने 1944 में भारतीय पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण (ASI) के महानिदेशक के रूप में पदभार ग्रहण किया। उन्होंने हड़प्पा सभ्यता की खुदाई का कार्य किया और इस सभ्यता के बारे में महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी प्रदान की। व्हीलर ने हड़प्पा और मोहनजोदड़ो की खुदाई में वैज्ञानिक तरीकों का उपयोग किया, जिससे इन स्थलों के बारे में नई जानकारी मिली। उन्होंने हड़प्पा सभ्यता के किलेबंदी और नगर नियोजन के बारे में विस्तृत अध्ययन किया।

Extra Facts:
हड़प्पा सभ्यता विश्व की प्राचीनतम नगरीय सभ्यताओं में से एक है, जो 2600-1900 ईसा पूर्व फली-फूली। इस सभ्यता की खोज दया राम साहनी और राखल दास बनर्जी ने की थी। जॉन मार्शल ने ASI के महानिदेशक के रूप में हड़प्पा सभ्यता के अध्ययन को बढ़ावा दिया। व्हीलर के कार्यकाल में पुरातत्व विज्ञान में नई तकनीकों का प्रयोग शुरू हुआ।

question:
Which of the following Harappan sites is NOT located in Gujarat?

[CONSTABLE EXECUTIVE ]
options: Amri
Lothal
Rangpur
Dholavira
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is [Amri]

Explanation:
Amri is a major Harappan site, but it is located in Sindh, Pakistan, not in Gujarat. It contains remains from the early and mature phases of the Harappan civilization. On the other hand, Lothal, Rangpur, and Dholavira are prominent Harappan sites located in Gujarat. Lothal was a port city, while Dholavira is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its advanced water management system.

Extra Facts:
The Harappan Civilization (2600-1900 BCE) was one of the world's earliest urban civilizations. Dholavira in Gujarat is famous for its sophisticated drainage system and large stepwell. Lothal provides evidence of boat-making, indicating maritime trade activities.

☛ Dholavira – Located in the Rann of Kutch, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
☛ Rangpur – Late Harappan site in Gujarat
☛ Mohenjo-Daro – Located in Sindh, Pakistan (famous for the 'Great Bath')
☛ Harappa – Located in Punjab, Pakistan, the civilization is named after this site
question_hi:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा हड़प्पा स्थल गुजरात में स्थित नहीं है?

[CONSTABLE EXECUTIVE ]
options_hi: अमरी
लोथल
रंगपुर
धोलावीरा
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है [अमरी]

Explanation:
अमरी एक प्रमुख हड़प्पा कालीन स्थल है, लेकिन यह गुजरात में नहीं, बल्कि सिंध, पाकिस्तान में स्थित है। यहाँ से हड़प्पा संस्कृति के प्रारंभिक और परिपक्व चरण के अवशेष मिले हैं। दूसरी ओर, लोथल, रंगपुर और धोलावीरा गुजरात में स्थित प्रमुख हड़प्पा स्थल हैं। लोथल एक बंदरगाह शहर था, जबकि धोलावीरा को यूनेस्को की विश्व धरोहर स्थल घोषित किया गया है।

Extra Facts:
हड़प्पा सभ्यता (2600-1900 ईसा पूर्व) विश्व की प्राचीन नगरीय सभ्यताओं में से एक थी। गुजरात में स्थित धोलावीरा अपने जल प्रबंधन प्रणाली और विशाल सीढ़ीदार कुएँ के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। लोथल से नाव बनाने के साक्ष्य मिले हैं, जो व्यापारिक गतिविधियों को दर्शाते हैं।

☛ धोलावीरा - कच्छ के रण में स्थित, यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल

question:
Which of the following sites of Indus Valley Civilization is located in Punjab (India)?

[NTPC CBT 2]
options: Banawali
Balu
Kot diji
Ropar
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ropar

Explanation:
Ropar is an important archaeological site of the Indus Valley Civilization, currently located in Punjab (India). It was discovered by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) between 1953-56. The site contains remains from both the Harappan and post-Harappan periods, including pottery, seals, copper tools, and evidence of burial practices. Ropar is situated on the banks of the Sutlej River, indicating its role in trade and agriculture during that era.

Extra Facts:
Ropar, also known as Rupnagar, represents the eastern expansion of the Indus Valley Civilization. Excavations here revealed a human skeleton with a dog, suggesting domestication. The pottery found here features red and black paintings, typical of Harappan art.

Expected Questions for Upcoming Exams :
☛ Banawali - Located in Haryana, evidence of barley and wheat cultivation found here.
☛ Balu - A minor Harappan site in Haryana, known for pottery findings.
☛ Kot Diji - Located in Sindh (Pakistan), an early Harappan site.
☛ Harappa - Major Indus city in Pakistan, the civilization is named after it.
☛ Mohenjo-Daro - Largest Indus city, nicknamed 'Mound of the Dead'.
question_hi:
सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का निम्न में से कौन सा स्थल पंजाब (भारत) में स्थित है ?

[NTPC CBT 2]
options_hi: बनवाली
बालू
कोट दिजी
रोपड़
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है रोपड़

Explanation:
रोपड़ (Ropar) सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का एक महत्वपूर्ण पुरातात्विक स्थल है, जो वर्तमान में पंजाब (भारत) में स्थित है। इसकी खोज 1953-56 में भारतीय पुरातत्व सर्वेक्षण (ASI) द्वारा की गई थी। यहाँ से हड़प्पा और उत्तर-हड़प्पा काल के अवशेष मिले हैं, जिनमें मिट्टी के बर्तन, मोहरें, तांबे के औजार और दफनाने की प्रथाओं के साक्ष्य शामिल हैं। रोपड़ सतलज नदी के किनारे स्थित है, जो इस क्षेत्र में व्यापार और कृषि के विकास को दर्शाता है।

Extra Facts:
रोपड़ को 'रूपनगर' भी कहा जाता है और यह सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता के पूर्वी विस्तार को दर्शाता है। यहाँ से मिले कुछ अवशेषों में कुत्ते के साथ मानव कंकाल भी शामिल है, जो पालतू जानवरों के साथ संबंध को दर्शाता है। इस स्थल से प्राप्त मिट्टी के बर्तनों पर लाल और काले रंग की चित्रकारी पाई गई है, जो हड़प्पा कला का उदाहरण है।

Expected Questions for Upcoming Exams :

☛ बालू - हरियाणा का एक छोटा हड़प्पा स्थल, जहाँ से मिट्टी के बर्तन मिले हैं।
☛ कोट दिजी - पाकिस्तान के सिंध प्रांत में स्थित, प्रारंभिक हड़प्पा काल का स्थल।
☛ हड़प्पा - पाकिस्तान में स्थित, सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का प्रमुख नगर।
☛ मोहनजोदड़ो - सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का सबसे बड़ा नगर, 'मृतकों का टीला' कहलाता है।

question:
Which of the following archaeological sites is located outside the state of Gujarat?

[CONSTABLE EXECUTIVE ]
options:
Dholavira

Rakhigarhi

Rangpur

Amarpura
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Rakhigarhi

Explanation:
Rakhigarhi is located in Haryana, outside Gujarat. It is a major archaeological site of the Indus Valley Civilization (Harappan Civilization) and is considered one of the largest Harappan sites in the world. Excavations here have revealed urban planning, drainage systems, pottery, and metal tools. The other options—Dholavira, Rangpur, and Amarpura—are located in Gujarat.

Extra Facts:
Rakhigarhi was discovered in 1963 and is among the five major cities of the Harappan Civilization. DNA evidence from this site has proven a genetic link between Harappan people and modern Indians. Seals and beads found here are excellent examples of Harappan art.

Expected Questions for Upcoming Exams :
☛ Dholavira - Located in Gujarat, a UNESCO World Heritage Site (ruins, water management system)
☛ Rangpur - Located in Gujarat, a Harappan-era site (contemporary to Lothal)
☛ Amarpura - Located in Gujarat, a minor Harappan site
☛ Harappa - Located in Pakistan, the first discovered site of the Indus Valley Civilization
☛ Mohenjo-Daro - Located in Pakistan, the largest urban center of the Harappan Civilization
question_hi:

[CONSTABLE EXECUTIVE ]
options_hi:
धोलावीरा

राखीगढ़ी

रंगपुर

अमरपुरा
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है राखीगढ़ी

Explanation:
राखीगढ़ी हरियाणा राज्य में स्थित है, जो गुजरात से बाहर है। यह सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता (हड़प्पा सभ्यता) का एक प्रमुख पुरातात्विक स्थल है और विश्व के सबसे बड़े हड़प्पा कालीन स्थलों में से एक माना जाता है। यहाँ से मिले अवशेषों में नगर नियोजन, जल निकासी प्रणाली, मिट्टी के बर्तन और धातु के उपकरण शामिल हैं। अन्य विकल्प—धोलावीरा, रंगपुर और अमरपुरा—गुजरात में स्थित हैं।

Extra Facts:
राखीगढ़ी की खोज 1963 में हुई थी और यह हड़प्पा सभ्यता के पाँच प्रमुख शहरों में से एक है। यहाँ से मिले डीएनए साक्ष्य ने यह सिद्ध किया कि हड़प्पा सभ्यता के लोगों का आनुवंशिक संबंध आधुनिक भारतीयों से है। इस स्थल से प्राप्त मोहरें और मनके हड़प्पा कला के उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण हैं।

question:
The city of ______ was located on Khadir Beyt (also spelled as Bet) in the Rann of Kutch, where there was fresh water and fertile soil.

[SSC GD 2024]
options: Lothal
Dholavira
Harappa
Mohenjodaro
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dholavira

Explanation:
Dholavira was a major city of the Indus Valley Civilization, located on Khadir Beyt (or Bet) in the Rann of Kutch, Gujarat. This site had access to freshwater and fertile soil, making it suitable for settlement. The city is renowned for its advanced water management system, massive fortifications, and well-planned urban layout. A large signboard with 10 symbols was discovered here, considered one of the world's earliest 'signboards'.

Extra Facts:
Dholavira was one of the five largest cities of the Harappan civilization. Excavations revealed it was a hub of agriculture, trade, and craftsmanship. The site includes reservoirs, cemeteries, and multi-tiered residential complexes.

☛ Harappa – First discovered Indus Valley site (now in Pakistan)

☛ Kalibangan – Located in Rajasthan, known for twin towns
☛ Rakhigarhi – Largest Harappan site in Haryana
question_hi:

[SSC GD 2024]
options_hi: लोथल
धोलावीरा
हड़प्पा
मोहनजोदड़ो
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है धोलावीरा

Explanation:
धोलावीरा गुजरात के कच्छ के रण में स्थित एक प्रमुख हड़प्पा सभ्यता का शहर था। यह खादिर बेत (या बेट) नामक द्वीप पर बसा हुआ था, जहाँ ताज़ा पानी और उपजाऊ मिट्टी उपलब्ध थी। यह शहर अपनी उन्नत जल प्रबंधन प्रणाली, विशाल किलेबंदी और सुव्यवस्थित नगर योजना के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। धोलावीरा में 10 बड़े चिन्हों वाला एक विशाल बोर्ड भी मिला है, जिसे संभवतः दुनिया का सबसे पुराना 'साइनबोर्ड' माना जाता है।

Extra Facts:
धोलावीरा हड़प्पा सभ्यता के पांच बड़े शहरों में से एक था। यहाँ से मिले अवशेषों से पता चलता है कि यह शहर कृषि, व्यापार और शिल्प का प्रमुख केंद्र था। इसकी खुदाई में जलाशय, कब्रिस्तान और बहु-स्तरीय आवासीय परिसर भी मिले हैं।

Bhirrana is a significant Neolithic site located in the Fatehabad district of Haryana. This site dates back to the pre-Harappan period (7000-6000 BCE) and the archaeological findings suggest that the inhabitants were engaged in agriculture, animal husbandry, and pottery-making. Bhirrana is considered one of the oldest Neolithic sites in the Indian subcontinent. The geometric designs on the pottery found here reflect the artistic skills of that era.

Excavations at Bhirrana have revealed important artifacts such as remnants of wheat and barley, indicating early agricultural practices. This site provides crucial insights into the pre-Harappan era and helps in understanding the transition to the Indus Valley Civilization.

question:
Which of the following metals was used to make weapons and tools in Harappan cities?

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: Silver
Gold
Copper
Iron
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Copper

Explanation:
In the Harappan civilization (2600-1900 BCE), copper was widely used for making weapons and tools. It was the most important metal of that time because it was easily available and could be melted and molded without much difficulty. The Harappans also mixed copper with tin to produce bronze, which was used to make stronger tools and weapons. Iron was not used during this period as it became prevalent only in the Later Vedic Age (after 1000 BCE).

Extra Facts:
The Harappan civilization is also called the Bronze Age Civilization because of the use of bronze (a mixture of copper and tin). The Harappans were skilled in metallurgy and crafted various tools, knives, swords, axes, etc. Additionally, they used gold and silver for making ornaments, not weapons or tools.

question:

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options:

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

Sindh

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Sindh

Explanation:
Mohenjo-Daro, meaning 'Mound of the Dead', is one of the major cities of the Indus Valley Civilization. It is located in the Sindh province of present-day Pakistan, specifically in the Larkana District near the Indus River. The site was discovered in 1922 by R.D. Banerji. It is renowned for its advanced urban planning (grid pattern, Great Bath, drainage system) and flourished between 2600-1900 BCE as a key center of the Harappan Civilization.

Extra Facts:
The Indus Valley Civilization is also called the Harappan Civilization, named after its first discovered site, Harappa (Punjab, Pakistan). Mohenjo-Daro is the UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The people excelled in trade, metallurgy, and seal-making. The seals of Mohenjo-Daro depict animals (e.g., unicorn-like creature) and an undeciphered script.

The Great Bath found at Mohenjo-daro was a rectangular tank , measuring approximately 12 meters long, 7 meters wide, and 2.4 meters deep . It is one of the most iconic structures of the Harappan Civilization. It was likely used for religious rituals or communal bathing . The tank was constructed with baked bricks and lined with a waterproof plaster . It exemplifies the advanced water management and public sanitation of the Indus Valley Civilization.

Extra Facts:
Mohenjo-daro (meaning 'Mound of the Dead') is located in Sindh, Pakistan, and was a major city of the Harappan Civilization ( 2600-1900 BCE ). It was discovered in 1922 by R.D. Banerji . The civilization featured grid-patterned streets, drainage systems, granaries, and wells , showcasing urban planning.

question:
Which of the following sites is located on the Ghod river, a tributary of the Bhima ?

[SSC GD 2024]
options:
Kot Diji

Banawali

Inamgaon

Chanhudaro
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Inamgaon

Explanation:
Inamgaon is a significant archaeological site located in the Pune district of Maharashtra, situated on the banks of the Ghod River, a tributary of the Bhima River. It is a prominent Chalcolithic (Copper-Stone Age) site, dating back to approximately 1600-700 BCE. Excavations here have revealed evidence of agriculture, animal husbandry, and metallurgy. The findings include pottery, tools, and residential structures, providing insights into the socio-economic life of prehistoric communities.

Extra Facts:
Artifacts from Inamgaon indicate that its inhabitants cultivated barley, wheat, and pulses. There is also evidence of cattle, sheep, goats, and pigs being reared. The site is associated with the Malwa Culture, and skeletal remains from graves have helped researchers understand the lifestyle and customs of its people.

question:
Which of the following architectural elements is excluded from the construction sites of the Indus Valley Civilisation?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options:
Iron Slabs

Sun Dried Bricks

Baked Bricks

Mortar of Gypsum
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Iron Slabs

Explanation:
The Iron Slabs were not used in the construction sites of the Indus Valley Civilisation (2600-1900 BCE). This civilisation belonged to the Bronze Age, where iron was not yet in use. Instead, the people of the Indus Valley used sun-dried bricks, baked bricks, and mortar of gypsum for construction. Their architecture included well-planned cities, advanced drainage systems, and large public baths (e.g., the 'Great Bath' of Mohenjo-Daro).

Extra Facts:
The Indus Valley Civilisation had advanced urban planning with grid-patterned cities, efficient drainage systems, and durable bricks. Since it predates the Iron Age, no evidence of iron tools or construction materials has been found.

question:
Inamgaon, an important Archaeological site is situated on ______ river.

[SSC MTS ]
options: Indrayani
Ulhas
Ghod
Kukadi
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ghod

Explanation:
Inamgaon is a significant archaeological site located on the banks of the Ghod River in Maharashtra. It belongs to the Chalcolithic period (Copper-Stone Age) (1600-700 BCE) and is associated with the Jorwe culture. Excavations here have revealed evidence of agriculture (wheat, barley, pulses), animal husbandry (cows, buffaloes, sheep-goats), and advanced pottery. The site provides insights into the social and economic life of prehistoric rural communities in India.

Extra Facts:
Inamgaon's excavations uncovered multi-room houses, storage pits, and burial sites, indicating a well-organized society. Human skeletons buried with grave goods (pottery, ornaments) suggest beliefs in afterlife. The site is crucial for understanding the transition from hunting-gathering to settled farming in ancient India.

Explanation:
Mohenjodaro, a major site of the Harappan civilization, is located on the bank of the Indus River. It is situated in the Sindh province of present-day Pakistan. Mohenjodaro, meaning 'Mound of the Dead,' was one of the most developed cities of the Harappan civilization. Excavations here have revealed a Great Bath, granaries, a grid-based street system, and advanced drainage, showcasing the civilization's urban planning.

Extra Facts:
The Harappan civilization (2600-1900 BCE) is also called the Indus Valley Civilization because most of its sites are located along the Indus River and its tributaries. Mohenjodaro was discovered by Rakhaldas Banerjee in 1922. The people of this civilization developed bronze-age technology, seals, standardized weights, and trade networks.

question:
On which river was Harappa city discovered during excavations around the year 1920-21?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options:
Ravi

Beas

Jhelum

Chenab
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ravi

Explanation:
The city of Harappa was discovered during excavations around 1920-21 on the banks of the Ravi River. It was a major urban center of the Indus Valley Civilization (2600-1900 BCE). The discovery was made by archaeologists Daya Ram Sahni and Madho Sarup Vats. Harappa and Mohenjo-Daro were the two largest cities of this civilization. Located near the Ravi River, Harappa was crucial for trade and agriculture. Artifacts like seals, beads, and pottery found here reflect the advanced urbanization of this civilization.

Extra Facts:
The Indus Valley Civilization is one of the world's oldest urban civilizations. Its cities featured planned drainage systems, brick houses, and public baths (e.g., the 'Great Bath' of Mohenjo-Daro). This civilization was known for its trade networks, with evidence of contacts as far as Mesopotamia.

रावी

ब्यास

झेलम

चेनाब
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है रावी

Explanation:
हड़प्पा शहर की खोज 1920-21 के दौरान रावी नदी के तट पर हुई थी। यह सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता (2600-1900 ईसा पूर्व) का एक प्रमुख शहर था। इसकी खोज दयाराम साहनी और माधोस्वरूप वत्स ने की थी। हड़प्पा और मोहनजोदड़ो इस सभ्यता के दो सबसे बड़े शहर थे। रावी नदी के तट पर स्थित होने के कारण यह व्यापार और कृषि के लिए महत्वपूर्ण था। यहाँ से मिली मुहरें, मनके और अन्य कलाकृतियाँ इस सभ्यता के उन्नत शहरीकरण को दर्शाती हैं।

Extra Facts:
सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता विश्व की प्राचीनतम नगरीय सभ्यताओं में से एक थी। इसके शहरों में सुनियोजित जल निकासी व्यवस्था, ईंटों के बने घर और सार्वजनिक स्नानागार (जैसे मोहनजोदड़ो का 'महान स्नानागार') थे। यह सभ्यता व्यापारिक संबंधों के लिए भी जानी जाती थी, जिसमें मेसोपोटामिया से संपर्क के प्रमाण मिले हैं।

question:
The Harappan brought Gold from present-day _______ in India.

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: Telangana
Tamil Nadu
Karnataka
Kerala
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Karnataka

Explanation:
The Harappan civilization (2600-1900 BCE) traded in gold, which was sourced from present-day Karnataka. The Harappans primarily obtained gold from the Kolar mines (Karnataka), a region historically famous for gold production. They had trade links with South India, importing precious metals like gold and silver.

☛ Its major sites include Mohenjo-Daro, Harappa, Dholavira, and Lothal.
☛ The Harappans also traded with Mesopotamia.
☛ Apart from gold, they used metals like copper, tin, and lead.

question_hi:
हड़प्पा के लोग भारत में वर्तमान_____से सोना लाते थे।

[SSC CGL 2022]
options_hi: तेलंगाना
तमिलनाडु
कर्नाटक
केरल
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है कर्नाटक

Explanation:
हड़प्पा सभ्यता (2600-1900 ईसा पूर्व) के लोग सोने का व्यापार करते थे और यह सोना वर्तमान कर्नाटक के क्षेत्र से आता था। हड़प्पावासी मुख्य रूप से कोलार की खानों (कर्नाटक) से सोना प्राप्त करते थे। यह क्षेत्र प्राचीन काल से ही सोने के लिए प्रसिद्ध रहा है। हड़प्पा सभ्यता के व्यापारिक संबंध दक्षिण भारत के साथ थे, जहाँ से वे कीमती धातुएँ जैसे सोना और चाँदी आयात करते थे।

Extra Facts:

☛ इस सभ्यता के प्रमुख स्थल मोहनजोदड़ो, हड़प्पा, धोलावीरा और लोथल हैं।
